data.exact_reserve_text: Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred: 2020 YOA: At end of first underwriting year 65, One year later 5,305, Two years later 7,648.
data.standardized_narrative: For the 2022 financial year, the Syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 2.343 million, representing 41.0% of the opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was identified for the 2020 underwriting year, where the estimated cumulative gross claims incurred increased from GBP 5.305 million (one year later estimate) to GBP 7.648 million (two years later estimate). No specific causal factors for this movement were detailed in the report.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table for the 2020 underwriting year. This shows a strengthening of gross claims incurred. This appears to contradict the 'Forecast result' of a GBP 255k profit for the 2020 YOA mentioned on page 3 and the '2020 year of account profits' mentioned on page 18, which likely refer to the net underwriting result after all income and expenses, not solely gross claims development.
